headline: Install counters are repo-level cached event streams written into many per-listing counters: 119/160 listings sit in equal-increment cohorts with up to 597k lifetime spread; listing-level sums overstate the market 3.15x (572,375 naive vs 181,881 repo-enveloped); counters update in bursts (19/160 moved in 1.55h, zero new movers); weekly series frozen at every horizon; and our category has 100k-1.1M installs under market-research/competitor-analysis naming while our own listing sits at 1 install
limits: cohort equality inferred from near-identical deltas, not event logs
repo-level attribution not separable from shared-series model without event logs
skills.sh counters are installs, not usage
next: E80 re-crawl same 160 listings at +26h to test whether burst cohorts recur at the same repos
E81 repo-level map of the market-research/competitor-analysis cluster
E82 measure our own listing counter over >=72h to distinguish floor vs stale cache
